name: zmath_mat_transform_point_batch_in_place
description: zMath::MatTransformPointBatchInPlace transforms each zVec3 in place by the current 4x3 matrix and skips work when the current matrix is marked identity or the count is zero.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zMath matrix/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja evidence for 0x4747d0 validates ECX as the zVec3 array, EDX as count, the current-matrix identity flag early return, count-zero early return, loading the active zMat4x3 through g_zMath_CurrentMatrixSlotPtr, and the in-place x/y/z transform loop with x/z/y store order.
The native zMath smoke verifies identity skip, count-zero skip, and single-entry transform while leaving later entries untouched.
